T1.note: unit + demos + non-Docker integration (integration/services subtree excluded - it is Docker-real and runs in T2); floor = measured minus ~2% slack. Raised for 12.3, then 12.2.6 (test tie-back: testref models, ingestion API, reconcile/history, control-runtime results pickup). Re-measured at the end of the 12.2.6/12.4 wave: the previous 1523 was taken mid-wave, before the tie-back suites (test-refs list API, blocks-done activation, manifest contract, CLI reconcile) and the 12.4 routing tests had all landed. Raise when suites grow (ratchet up, never down without a PLAN.md note).

T2.note: Docker-dependent integration (tdd/integration/services: executor + 12.2-INT workspace lifecycle/local pipeline/WS round-trip suites + 12.3 HOME-persistence + base-image contracts on lazyaf-base:dev). Docker down fails loudly in the shared docker_client fixture (tdd/integration/conftest.py). Step images are a PREFLIGHT: run_tier.py T2 runs `build_images.py --check` before pytest and exits loudly with the rebuild command, so the '12.3-images:' skip reason is gone from skip_baseline.json and image-dependent tests always execute under the gate - the floor counts them. Re-measured after the 12.2.6/12.4 wave (base-image contract suite grew with the LAZYAF_TEST_RESULTS_PATH runtime contracts).

T3.note: e2e quick tier (tdd/e2e -m 'not slow'). Known exclusion (R4, stated not silent): the @slow e2e tests (control layer control-mode round trip, real card execution, graph pipeline full-stack) run in NO tier and have no floor here - they need the compose e2e stack, which a step container cannot host yet. Host-runnable via the scripts/test slow lane (control-layer tests additionally require lazyaf-base:dev built); they enter dogfood CI at Phase 12.4/12.5. Tier selections are single-sourced in scripts/run_tier.py.
